---
title: "Convex Optimization"
---

These are my personal notes based on Nesterov's *Introductory Lectures
on Convex Optimization*. The notes were designed for my personal use in finding useful optimization results quickly using latex. In the book, I required a deeper explanation for the theorems and proofs, motivating my construction of these notes to add explanations
for the theorems and certain proof steps.

> **Note:** These notes are currently a work in progress for Chapters 1 and Chapters 2 and may contain many
> errors. I plan to revise them and add substantially more exposition over time.

[Download the current notes (PDF)](convex-optimization-notes.pdf)
